evidence_notes: Ben, 49, male, diagnosed with Crohn's 18 months ago, likely had it longer. Also pre-diabetic and chronic back pain from work injury. Symptoms initially dismissed as job-related. Severe bleeding led to diagnosis of severe disease with multiple strictures. Prednisone worsened blood sugar. Mesalamine ineffective. Currently on Humira with ~50% improvement. Company placed him on desk duty due to missed work. Wife working double shifts. Financial strain, sold assets to cover medical bills. Union insurance covers some costs but 20% of biologics is still thousands.
